summary: Single VivaCity-style camera (counter 282) covering nine zones at Sunnyholt Rd / Devitt St, Blacktown, with no counter changes, so every counter-direction is its own series. The Jan-Mar 2024 outage is already handled; three shorter camera-wide outages (Jul 2023, Nov 2025, Aug 2026 with a backlog dump) are set missing for all zones, and zero_outage misfires on two near-empty zones are restored. A sudden ~2x step in several zones from 2024-11-07 is flagged uncertain as a possible camera reconfiguration.
